stories.title: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates says sorry to Wales for party’s worst ever election result
stories.summary: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates has apologised to the people of Wales for what he called the worst result in Welsh Labour’s history. stories.summary: The motion says the money was restored only after an amendment was carried against the wishes of the deputy leader who proposed the original motion.

stories.title: Police target drink and drug drivers overnight in South Flintshire after five arrests in 24 hours

stories.title: Lanterns  Light returns to Chester Zoo for 42 nights with a new route and new puppets
stories.summary: Lanterns  Light opened at Chester Zoo on Friday, and all tickets are £12 for evening slots from 6.30pm during November.
